guitar.caption: A lighthearted, minimal instrumental built on a warm nylon-string acoustic guitar figure and a soft, laid-back lo-fi hip-hop drum beat with a muted kick and a gentle rimshot. A round, subtle bassline supports the guitar. The arrangement stays sparse and uncluttered with plenty of space, like background music for a friendly app explainer video. No vocals.

piano.caption: A warm, playful and minimal instrumental with soft felt piano chords, light pizzicato strings and finger snaps over a gentle, laid-back drum groove with a soft kick. A round, mellow bass keeps it moving. Sparse and airy, leaving plenty of room, like background music for a friendly product story. No vocals.

mallets.caption: A light, quirky and minimal instrumental groove with wooden percussion, soft marimba and kalimba notes, a muted kick and handclaps, and a round plucked bass. Playful and clean with lots of space, like background music for an animated app explainer. No vocals.

rhodes.caption: A calm, sunny lo-fi instrumental with warm Rhodes electric piano chords, a dusty laid-back hip-hop beat, soft vinyl texture and a mellow round bass. Minimal and uncluttered, a relaxed background for a friendly product video. No vocals.

plucks.caption: A clean, minimal and friendly electronic instrumental with soft plucked synths, a gentle pad, a light muted kick and crisp finger snaps. Understated and airy with lots of space, calm and confident, like background music for a modern app explainer. No vocals.

ukulele.caption: A breezy, lighthearted acoustic instrumental with a strummed ukulele, soft hand percussion, a tambourine on the offbeat and a warm upright bass. Simple, sparse and sunny, like background music for a friendly animated product video. No vocals.
